##    Read in accelerometer data

```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)

path <- "/home/ajackson/Dropbox/Rprojects/RoughRoad/"

file <- "Portsmouth_Street-2026-08-20_19-28-35.zip"

Accel <- read_csv(unzip(paste0(path, file), "Accelerometer.csv"))
Location <- read_csv(unzip(paste0(path, file), "Location.csv"))


```

##      quick plot

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

Accel |> 
  ggplot(aes(y=z, x=seconds_elapsed)) +
  geom_line()

```
